title: Easy Ore Generation
description: Generate a random ore! Then, once you find the one you want, generate more infinitely!
body:
This is a simple mod to generate ores! There are 2 blocks:

- Random Ore Generator (Generates a random ore above it)
- Precise Ore Generator (Generates ore from above and places in an inventory connected to the front)

Compatibility:

Any mod that registers its ores with NeoForge.

This mod was inspired by [Simple Sky Resource Generators](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simple-sky-resource-generators) mod for Minecraft version 1.20.1
